title: Specsync comment must exit with the verdict it prints, so a failing comment fails the CI step that posted it
description: specsync comment must exit with the verdict it prints, so a failing comment fails the CI step that posted it
acceptance_criteria: A project that fails validation makes 'specsync comment' exit non-zero, matching the exit code of 'specsync check' on the same project and matching the verdict rendered in the comment body it prints. A passing project still exits zero. '--require-coverage N' is honored by 'comment' exactly as it is by 'check', 'score', 'report' and 'deps': a tree below the threshold exits non-zero. The comment body itself is unchanged; only the process exit status is corrected.
